items.title: DeepFEAv2: Deep Learning for Transient Finite Element Analysis Beyond Structured Meshes
items.category: AIによる設計・FEA・サロゲート
items.excerpt: DeepFEAv2 targets transient FEA across structured and unstructured meshes and multiple element types. On 3D linear-elastic and aortic-valve datasets, the authors report R² up to 0.99, normalized error down to 0.38%, and inference up to three orders of magnitude faster than conventional FEA.

items.excerpt: KATOsuper couples neural-reparameterized topology optimization with a sensitivity-consistent Fourier neural operator. items.title: Stable time-stepping via residual minimization: finite-element and neural-network approximations for transient parabolic problems
items.excerpt: The authors develop a minimum-residual time-stepping framework applicable to both finite-element and neural-network trial approximations.
